require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'securerandom'
require 'logger'

module MobileAPI
  class AuditLogger
    def initialize(log_path)
      @logger = Logger.new(log_path)
      @logger.formatter = proc do |severity, datetime, progname, msg|
        "#{datetime.utc.iso8601} [#{severity}] #{msg}\n"
      end
    end

    def log_event(event_type, metadata = {})
      entry = { event: event_type, timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601 }.merge(metadata)
      @logger.info(entry.to_json)
    end

    def log_crypto_operation(operation, key_id, context)
      log_event('crypto_op', { operation: operation, key_id: key_id, context: context })
    end
  end

  class KeyDerivationService
    MASTER_SECRET = ENV.fetch('MASTER_SECRET', 'default_dev_secret_do_not_use')
    KEY_VERSION = 2

    def initialize(audit_logger)
      @audit = audit_logger
      @key_cache = {}
    end

    def derive_key(purpose, context_id)
      cache_key = "#{purpose}:#{context_id}"
      return @key_cache[cache_key] if @key_cache.key?(cache_key)

      salt = compute_salt(purpose, context_id)
      derived = OpenSSL::KDF.hkdf(
        MASTER_SECRET,
        salt: salt,
        info: "v#{KEY_VERSION}",
        length: 32,
        hash: 'SHA256'
      )

      key_id = Base64.urlsafe_encode64(derived[0..3])
      @audit.log_crypto_operation('derive', key_id, { purpose: purpose, ctx: context_id })
      @key_cache[cache_key] = derived
      derived
    end

    private

    def compute_salt(purpose, context_id)
      # Domain separation via purpose-specific salt
      OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.digest("#{purpose}|#{KEY_VERSION}")
    end
  end

  class TokenService
    PURPOSE_AUTH = 'authentication'
    PURPOSE_ENCRYPT = 'encryption'

    def initialize(key_service, audit_logger)
      @keys = key_service
      @audit = audit_logger
    end

    def generate_auth_token(user_id, device_id)
      key = @keys.derive_key(PURPOSE_AUTH, user_id)
      payload = { sub: user_id, dev: device_id, iat: Time.now.to_i, exp: Time.now.to_i + 3600 }
      sign_payload(payload, key, user_id)
    end

    def encrypt_sensitive_data(user_id, plaintext)
      key = @keys.derive_key(PURPOSE_ENCRYPT, user_id)
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher::AES.new(256, :GCM)
      cipher.encrypt
      cipher.key = key
      iv = cipher.random_iv
      cipher.auth_data = user_id.to_s

      ciphertext = cipher.update(plaintext) + cipher.final
      tag = cipher.auth_tag

      @audit.log_event('encrypt', { user_id: user_id, data_len: plaintext.length })
      Base64.urlsafe_encode64(iv + tag + ciphertext)
    end

    def verify_auth_token(token_string, user_id)
      key = @keys.derive_key(PURPOSE_AUTH, user_id)
      parts = token_string.split('.')
      return nil unless parts.length == 2

      payload_json = Base64.urlsafe_decode64(parts[0])
      signature = Base64.urlsafe_decode64(parts[1])

      expected_sig = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('SHA256', key, payload_json)
      return nil unless secure_compare(expected_sig, signature)

      payload = JSON.parse(payload_json, symbolize_names: true)
      return nil if payload[:exp] < Time.now.to_i

      @audit.log_event('token_verify', { user_id: user_id, valid: true })
      payload
    end

    private

    def sign_payload(payload, key, user_id)
      payload_json = payload.to_json
      signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('SHA256', key, payload_json)
      token = "#{Base64.urlsafe_encode64(payload_json)}.#{Base64.urlsafe_encode64(signature)}"
      @audit.log_event('token_sign', { user_id: user_id })
      token
    end

    def secure_compare(a, b)
      return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
      OpenSSL.fixed_length_secure_compare(a, b)
    end
  end

  class App < Sinatra::Base
    configure do
      set :audit, AuditLogger.new(ENV.fetch('AUDIT_LOG', '/var/log/mobile_api/audit.log'))
      set :key_service, KeyDerivationService.new(settings.audit)
      set :token_service, TokenService.new(settings.key_service, settings.audit)
    end

    before do
      content_type :json
    end

    post '/api/v1/auth/token' do
      body = JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)
      user_id = body[:user_id]
      device_id = body[:device_id]

      halt 400, { error: 'missing params' }.to_json unless user_id && device_id

      token = settings.token_service.generate_auth_token(user_id, device_id)
      settings.audit.log_event('auth_token_issued', { user_id: user_id, device_id: device_id })
      { token: token }.to_json
    end

    post '/api/v1/data/encrypt' do
      auth_header = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']
      halt 401, { error: 'unauthorized' }.to_json unless auth_header&.start_with?('Bearer ')

      token = auth_header.sub('Bearer ', '')
      user_id = params[:user_id] || JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)[:user_id]

      payload = settings.token_service.verify_auth_token(token, user_id)
      halt 401, { error: 'invalid token' }.to_json unless payload

      plaintext = params[:data] || JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)[:data]
      encrypted = settings.token_service.encrypt_sensitive_data(user_id, plaintext)
      { encrypted: encrypted }.to_json
    end
  end
end
